claim: Napoleon.exe (32-bit, no manifest) is under UAC file virtualization: once one write of the proxy into the game folder failed (2026-10-30 14:44, the on_virtual rename of headless_status.json), Windows made copies in %LOCALAPPDATA%\VirtualStore\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Napoleon Total War\napoleon_remastered\ (headless_status.json, state.json) and every later write went there, silently, while the watcher read the stale real files: every launch then failed HEADLESS FAILED with the game itself fine. ctl.py Pc.launch moves the copies to <state>\_to_delete before a launch; the proxy-side fix (a manifest without virtualization, or retrying the rename) is J16's
